remaining_limits: Search indexes and public release pages may lag; field-wide completeness is not established.
The original November 18 report is preserved separately. This recheck confirms one new submission and three revisions, so its earlier zero result is not a verified absence.
Only selected listing portions inspected. cs.GR recent and cs.CV second month page were opened; cs.HC, cs.MM and eess.IV were rotated. cs.AI/cs.RO listings were not opened in this pass.
OpenReview group rendered only Loading; venue schedule exposed headings but no paper-specific publication timestamps. Restricted web searches supplemented these sources.
Fresh detailed reads were limited to four methods; the other six plausible records had identity/date and abstract-level rechecks. Revision content differences remain unassessed.
Ten search batches and 24 attempted primary opens are count caps; retrieval stops when those caps are reached. Actual elapsed time is reported, not padded to six minutes.
Queries and page reads are grouped by tool invocation in the ledger; a source-family association does not imply every result in that batch came from that family.
Search snippets and historical daily claims are leads only. Full-paper reproduction, exhaustive listing scans, citation chaining, and independent experimental validation were not performed.
The tools field remains provisional; the bundled memory definition is internally inconsistent. Unclear cells mean insufficient inspected evidence, not an inferred negative.
publication: Reviewed local CLI skill run, synchronized to GitHub and the website by the authorized publishing workflow.
